name: o-control
description: Desktop companion for Onkyo CR-N775 receiver control via eISCP

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/eiscp/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/upnp/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/service/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tools/mock-receiver/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/raycast/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:agent-runner
scripts.build:app: npm run build:sidecar && npm run tauri:build -w @o-control/desktop -- --target aarch64-apple-darwin
